sources.locator: Barnabás Janzer and Richard Montgomery, Packing the largest trees in the tree packing conjecture (2026). Crossref record inspected. The Gyárfás tree packing conjecture states that any trees T_1..T_n with |T_i| = i pack edge-disjointly into K_n; Janzer and Montgomery pack the largest trees under degree conditions. The conjecture predicts a perfect packing (190 edges) for this fixed tree sequence; scores measure packing search on one instance.
